器官說明.中文: 天干也代表人的身體器官；如八字四柱與大運或與流年有相沖相剋者，那部份的身體器官較可能出問題。例如一個人的八字裡有甲庚相沖，身體最容易出現問題的器官為膽、頭、大腸和臍輪。
器官說明.英文: Heavenly Stems also represent human body organs. If there is a clash or harm between the Four Pillars, the Major Luck, or the Annual Pillar, those corresponding body parts are more likely to have issues. For example, if a person's BaZi has a Jia-Geng clash, the organs most prone to problems are the gallbladder, head, large intestine, and navel chakra.

中文.短句: 有權威。

英文.短句: The healer star: good for health, brings helpful people, and gives a flair for the metaphysical.
英文.解說: Literally 'Heavenly Doctor'. Indicates the person is a good healer, including having a strong interest or talent in metaphysics, and can use fortune-telling to help others. It is the earthly branch preceding the month branch (e.g., in a Yin month, the Tianyi star is Chou).

中文.解說: 主徒勞無功，預兆做事大多事倍功半，甚至白費氣力。

英文.解說: Indicates futile effort, suggesting that most tasks will require twice the work for half the result, or even wasted energy.

中文.短句: 男怕天羅（亥戌），女怕地網（辰巳），兩者必須連在一起，代表坐牢或困在同一個地方。
中文.解說: 男怕天羅（亥戌），女怕地網（辰巳），兩者必須連在一起，代表坐牢或困在同一個地方。八字很多土受困於土中央，男怕【天羅】女怕【地網】。

英文.短句: Men fear the net of heaven (亥戌), women fear the net of earth (辰巳); together they mean being trapped or confined.
英文.解說: Men fear the net of heaven (Hai-Xu), women fear the net of earth (Chen-Si); together they mean being trapped or confined. A BaZi with too much Earth means being trapped in the center of Earth. Men fear the 'Net of Heaven', women fear the 'Net of Earth'.

中文.短句: 财务损失
中文.解說: 八字出現代表破財,總是莫名其妙失去很多錢。

英文.解說: Indicates financial loss in the BaZi: women like to buy luxury brands and diamonds; men lose money in stocks or get scammed, always inexplicably losing a lot of money.

中文.解說: 失去自由包括身心自由。

英文.解說: Loss of freedom, including physical and mental freedom.

中文.解說: 死亡尤其是輕生。

英文.解說: Risk of death, especially suicide.

沖.英文: The clash lands on the day pillar (marriage palace) — this is the single biggest influence on the marriage or partnership: strain, time apart or a turning point. Say important things face to face; do not go silent.

害.中文: 害到日柱（影響夫妻宮）—夫妻（伴侶）之間容易有悶氣與誤會，講開比猜心重要。
害.英文: The harm lands on the day pillar (marriage palace) — quiet friction and misunderstanding between partners; talking it out matters more than guessing.

刑.英文: The punishment lands on the day pillar (marriage palace) — tempers flare most easily with those closest; handle feelings before facts.

合.英文: The combination lands on the day pillar (marriage palace) — love and cooperation come closer and agreements are easier; a current you can use.
